# GARAGISTE parity baseline — the accepted divergence between the claude and opencode flavors, after normalization
# (scripts/parity-check.mjs rewrites the claude side into opencode vocabulary first). Written by
# `node scripts/parity-check.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A `git diff` of this file shows which divergent
# lines a change touched. Content lines are word-diffs, claude [-removed-] and opencode {+added+}; structure lines
# compare a doc with its .ko.md translation per section; coverage lists files with no counterpart.

coverage
  claude-only: claude/.claude/agents/team-builder.md

claude/.claude/skills/build/SKILL.md ↔ opencode/commands/build.md
  0. read the plan file (it is short). If the current branch is already plan/<slug> (a /spawn [-or `opencode --worktree` checkout,-] {+worktree,+} or the board names it), stay on it and continue from the step after the last PASS the board records (a plan amended with `Revised: <date> (from step k)` continues at step k — the steps before it are unchanged and already committed; a header still marked `draft` is not approved: stop and say so) — or, without a board, after the last step commit on the branch (`git log --format=%s%n%b main..HEAD` names plan and step); step 1 when there is neither. In a linked worktree on any other branch, stay on it too — the branch was cut when the worktree was made. Otherwise, on main: apply the branches-and-sync rule (synced), make sure the plan file is committed (`git status --porcelain <plan path>` prints nothing; if not, commit it yourself as `docs(plan): NNNN-<slug>` first), then `git switch -c plan/<slug>` yourself (slug from the plan filename). If that branch already exists locally or as origin/plan/<slug>: `git switch plan/<slug>` when its PR is not MERGED (`gh pr view plan/<slug> --json state -q .state`, or no remote) — an abandoned earlier run continues there; when it is MERGED, stop and ask the CEO to delete it first. One plan = one branch. Record the plan and branch in docs/STATUS.md (Shipped: —; in a linked worktree skip the board — it is the main checkout's). Uncommitted changes beyond docs-only files on the branch are an interrupted step's work: name them to team-implementer as that step's starting point (it runs the step's tests first and continues from there) instead of starting the step over.
  When all steps are done, run full verification with team-verifier — the independent verdict on the whole plan. On PASS, record `Last verifier: PASS full @<hash>` (`git log -1 --format=%H`) in docs/STATUS.md so /ship can reuse it. On FAIL, add one to the board's `verifier FAIL` count and pass the report verbatim to team-implementer together with the plan's step list (it locates the step by commit, fixes and commits); team-verifier confirms with full verification (max 3 rounds; past that, stop and report to the CEO). [-If the CEO invoked /build directly,-] {+Then+} suggest `/review` to the CEO in a sentence [-(inside-] {+— except in+} a [-/run chain,-] {+/spawn worktree session (the directory is not the first line of `git worktree list`): there, end with "close this session and+} run [-continues).-] {+`/integrate` in the main session" — the branch is reviewed, merged and shipped from there, never from the worktree.+}

Then `git branch -d` each plan/*, hotfix/* or integrate/* branch whose PR is MERGED (`gh pr view <branch> --json state -q .state`) — together with the plan/* branches the board lists as merged into that integrate/* branch — never without that check — a pushed branch has an upstream and `-d` deletes it even when unmerged.

  - 팀, `/kickoff`: 기획서에서 헌장 도출(기획서가 비운 곳은 팀의 기본값, 모두 docs/DECISIONS.md에 기록) → 디자인 기반(컴포넌트, 토큰, 셸, 스크린샷 명령)과 보안 기준선(인증, 비밀, 검증, 헤더, rate limit, 감사 — 항목마다 결정 또는 "해당 없음")을 담은 스택 ADR(critic 리뷰) → 질문 한 번(스택, 예산, 그리고 돈이 들거나 보안에 닿는 미결 항목만) → 골격(스모크 테스트 하나가 통과해 하네스가 생긴다) → AGENTS.md(Risk paths 씨앗과 실행 명령 줄)·ADR 확정·사양서(docs/specs/: 기획서의 채택 줄마다 파일 하나, 브레인스토밍에서 당신이 한 말 그대로, 색인은 docs/SPEC.md)·백로그(절마다 항목 하나)·walking skeleton 계획(핵심 흐름의 가장 얇은 조각)을 한 번에 → 전체 검증 → critic이 사양서와 계획을 리뷰(지적은 planner에게, 에스컬레이션 항목만 당신에게) → 문서 커밋 → [-예산 답으로 채용 적용(배정표 표시) →-] 상태판이 {+`/hire`(예산 답으로 적용, 배정표 표시)와+} `/run`을 가리킨다. 세션은 상태판을 쓴 채 끝난다. 첫 `/run`은 새 세션에서 한다(모델 배정은 세션 시작 때 로드된다) — 바로 시작하면 되고 `/handoff`는 필요 없다.

  - [-방식 1 (세션 병렬, 가장 견고): 터미널마다 `opencode --worktree <기능명>` → 각-] {+명령: 메인+} 세션에서 [-`/plan`-] {+`/spawn <계획 파일들>`+} → [-`/run`.-] {+팀이 계획마다 `../<레포>-<slug>` worktree와 `plan/<slug>` 브랜치를 만들고 새 터미널에서 실행할 명령을 알려준다 →+} 당신이 {+터미널을 열어 `cd ../<레포>-<slug> && opencode` → 그 세션에서 바로 `/build <계획>`(worktree 세션은 plan/<slug>에 머물고 상태판이 없다) → worktree 세션을 닫고, 끝난 브랜치는 메인 세션에서 `/integrate`로 main에서 딴 통합 브랜치(`integrate/<날짜>`)에 하나씩 머지 → `/ship`이 그 브랜치를+} PR [-순서대로 머지하고, 뒤 브랜치 세션에는 "main에 rebase 후 재검증"을 시킨다. `opencode --worktree` 세션에서는 `/plan`과 `/run`이 worktree의 브랜치에 머문다.-] {+하나(원격이 없으면 로컬 머지 하나)로 출하.+}

  CHARTER.md and STATUS.md are injected into every session (via [-the SessionStart hook).-] {+`instructions` in opencode.json).+} STATUS.md is committed at the cut points and changes uncommitted between them: the repository is the truth and the board the pointer, so a stale board is rewritten from git at the first turn of a session (the resume procedure). It belongs to the main checkout — a linked worktree carries a copy it must not edit; milestone commits (docs(brief), docs(plan), docs(kickoff), …) carry the durable state. BRIEF.md is never injected: the commands that need it name it.
